Parts.Text: On November 27, 2024, the F.O.R.T.I.S. Ukraine FIF Governing Committee met to seek resolution on the areas identified as not provisionally approved during the First Governing Committee Meeting on November 21, 2024, related to Governance/Voting Rights.

candidates.text: Governance/Voting Rights. The Governing Committee discussed and agreed in principle to language intended to seek resolution of the governance issues in a manner consistent with the fundamental principles of creating a FIF which is open to all World Bank members, treats them equitably, and is consistent with the multilateral approach to FIFs and development finance, while still meeting the needs of the original contributors to the F.O.R.T.I.S Ukraine FIF. The Meeting agreed that the Interim Secretariat would modify the relevant language in the Operations Manual and reflect the changes in the Governance Framework. With this agreement, the GC provisionally approved the full set of documents to establish the F.O.R.T.I.S. Ukraine FIF.
